question: Vinod Kevin Bachan has been selected for the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar 2021, for his contribution to which Indian dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vinod Kevin Bachan** has been recognized for his exceptional contribution to the Indian classical dance form **Odissi**. This prestigious recognition underlines his dedication to preserving and promoting this art form.
 
• The **Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar** is awarded by the **Sangeet Natak Akademi** to young artists under the age of 40 who have demonstrated talent and excellence in the fields of music, dance, and drama.
 
• **Odissi** is one of the **eight classical dance forms** of India and originates from the state of **Odisha**. It is characterized by its lyrical grace, fluid movements, and intricate gestures (mudras).
 
• This dance form is traditionally performed as a way to express devotion to Lord Jagannath, a deity worshipped in Odisha. It has a rich history of being performed in temples as a form of religious offering.
